full_judgment:
This Rule was issued calling upon the opposite parties to show cause as to why the impugned judgment and decree dated 11-11-2013 passed by the learned Additional District Judge, 2nd Court, Bogra in Other Class Appeal No.144 of 2013 allowing the appeal and reversing those dated 23- 9-2013 passed by the learned Assistant Judge, Bogra in Other Class Suit No.51 of 2013 should not be set-aside and/or such other or further order or orders passed as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 6. Against the said order of the learned Assistant Judge, the plaintiff-opposite parties preferred Other Class Appeal No.144 of 2013 before the learned District Judge, Bogra which was subsequently transferred to the Court of Additional District Judge, 2nd Court, Bogra for disposal, who by the impugned judgment and order dated 11-11-2013 allowed the appeal and set-aside the judgment and order dated 23-9-2013 passed by the learned Assistant Judge in Other Class Suit No. 51 of 20 13 rejecting the plaint.
